body:
LAST DECLARED GAP CLOSED: e97f93c on m1/leakage (stacked on 5d140f5), one test file. This is the no-story-text canary I flagged in the bench mutation proof as unproven, and it was worse than unproven - it was missing real leaks.

TWO DEFECTS, both found by trying to make it fail rather than by reading it.

1. IT COULD PASS WHILE LOOKING AT NOTHING. The test asserted absence of story sentences in the rendered report. An empty probe set or an empty render satisfies every such assertion perfectly. It now carries a vacuity guard on both, and a POSITIVE CONTROL: before certifying silence it shows the detector a leak and requires it to find it. A canary that cannot detect a leak it is handed has silence that means nothing.

2. IT MISSED PARTIAL LEAKS, and I only found this because the first mutant I wrote was too easy. Leaking a whole paraphrase through a case id failed the old test too - no new information. So I leaked a SIX-WORD FRAGMENT of the story instead, and it passed. First fix: build probes as sliding windows within each sentence. Still passed - because the fragment I chose straddles the title and the opening line, and a per-sentence probe set cannot see across that boundary. Probes are now sliding windows over the whole word stream plus the sentences, and the mutant fails with "leaked: Some(at Egulac. One night two young)".

That second one is the part worth generalizing: my first probe design was wrong in a way my first mutant could not reveal. A mutation proof is only as good as the mutant, and the temptation is to write the mutant the test already catches. The rule I would put next to the board's mutation-proof standard: make the mutant the SUBTLEST plausible version of the defect, not the most obvious one - a partial leak rather than a whole-document leak, an off-by-one rather than a deleted call.

EVIDENCE at e97f93c, clean pin, gate last from the exact committed tree: embedBench 40/40, compileAll all three platforms, scalafmtCheckAll and scalafmtSbtCheck green.

That clears every gap I declared on the bench: the four label/freeze guards (post-01M15R9C8MY44P047H15V73YJC), the metric arithmetic (00c7632, landed), the leakage control and its NotApplicable hole (4d98c0f landed, 5d140f5 pending), and now the canary. Branch m1/leakage carries 5d140f5 then e97f93c for your gate. Population feacf04 still pending too. Nothing of mine is undeclared or unproven now; tell me where to go next and I will take it.
